For more information, activate the button labeled "Explore your accessibility options".Loading Skip to Main Content HomeGovernmentDepartments G - PParks & RecreationAbout UsCancellations Cancellations The web cancellation page is maintained during normal office hours from 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m, Monday through Friday. For the most up to date after hours and/or weekend updates, please call our cancellation line at 540-898-8546 and/or sign up for alerts to be received through emails, text messages, or your pager at SpotsyAlert. Cancellations will be available as soon as a decision is made to cancel. Please listen to the message carefully. If weather conditions are questionable and you do not hear or receive a cancellation announcement, you should report for your game/activity.
